versions.changelog:
- Reference rule files moved to dedicated `references/` directory; updated all links in SKILL.md accordingly
- Removed redundant project docs: CHANGELOG.md and README.md
- Added new shared runtime rules: `gate-runtime-rules.md` and `info-news-runtime-rules.md`
- Cleaned up SKILL.md: improved rule references, clarified fallback/maintenance behaviors, and reorganized general rules section
- No changes to user-facing workflow, dependencies, or features

Initial release — listing & delisting announcement tracker for major exchanges.

- Tracks new exchange listings, delistings, and maintenance announcements, with support for Binance, Gate, OKX, Bybit, Coinbase, and more.
- Aggregates latest announcements, supplements new listings with coin fundamentals and market data.
- Structured exchange activity report includes summaries, risk warnings, and flags for abnormal moves or liquidity risks.
- Supports trigger keywords and natural language detection for routing to related briefing, coin analysis, or risk check features.
- No API keys or credentials required; operates via read-only MCP news and info endpoints.
